steps.name: Rossati Mafioso
steps.text: Back up, this one's tricky.

steps.name: Rossati Mafioso
steps.text: Don't fight her head on.

steps.name: Rossati Mafioso
steps.text: Cover the aisles and the stairs leading up to the Donna's box!

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Tsk, tsk. Rossati soldiers are pretty capable after all, huh.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Looks like trying to brute force my way through isn't a realistic option.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Hmm...

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Haha, silly Texas. It's pretty obvious she's got a recorder in that bass.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Sounds convincing, though, the way she's plucking those strings.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Haha, there it is.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: If I can't break through the front... I'll just have to make a path!

steps.name: Rossati Mafioso
steps.text: Don't panic!

steps.name: Rossati Mafioso
steps.text: Stand your ground!

steps.name: Bellone Mafioso
steps.text: Gah, aren't you afraid to die?

steps.name: Rossati Mafioso
steps.text: Guh... Urgh...

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: How are the others doing?

steps.name: Bellone Mafioso
steps.text: The aisles and stairs leading to Giovanna's box are all guarded.

steps.name: Bellone Mafioso
steps.text: They were ready for this.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: Leave it to the Rossatis...

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: But, we've never been ones to underestimate Giovanna.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: Throw more soldiers at them. We're not letting Giovanna out today.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: You might not have underestimated Giovanna, but don't you think you underestimated me?

steps.name: Bellone Mafioso
steps.text: What—

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: You're... Wallach.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: Heh, had I known the show today would've been so exciting, I wouldn't have gone to buy a drink for the Donna.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: If Signora Giovanna appreciates a fine wine, I happen to have a selection with me.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: No thanks.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: The Donna enjoys many things about Siracusa, but the wine isn't one.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: Siracusan wines are too weak, same as you people swing your weapons. Doesn't make for a good time.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: Maybe you just haven't tried the best Siracusa has to offer.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: So, isn't this a great opportunity?

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: Do you know how long I've been waiting for this?

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: Bellones and Saluzzos, let's find out what Siracusa's finest wine really tastes like.

steps.name: Rossati Mafioso
steps.text: Trying to get up this way?

steps.name: Rossati Mafioso
steps.text: Stop her!

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Who said I was going up?

steps.name: Rossati Mafioso
steps.text: What? Explosives?!

steps.name: Rossati Mafioso
steps.text: Get outta there!

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Woah, the seats over yonder just collapsed!

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Is that... Lappland?!

steps.name: Horrified Audience
steps.text: Look over there!

steps.name: Rossati Mafioso
steps.text: Urgh...

steps.name: Horrified Audience
steps.text: I-Is it another famiglie gang war...?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Move.

steps.name: Rossati Mafioso
steps.text: Sh-She had weapons in her instrument?!

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Texas!
Texas says nothing. She only shoots her a glance, parting her lips for a second before rushing up the stairs.
Sora reads those lips.
She said: 'Wait for me.'

steps.name: Panicked Audience
steps.text: Aaaaaahhh—! Run! Run for it!

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: What'cha think we oughta do, Exusiai? Sora's in danger!

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: But—

steps.name: Horrified Audience
steps.text: S-Someone, save me—

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Get down!

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Woah, you're pretty tough for an old guy.
Do I look that old to you?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Uhh... Well, I guess I wouldn't go that far.
Looks like today's performance is not 'La Morte di Texas,' but rather 'La Morte di Rossati.'
Find somewhere to hide, children.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: That sounds nice, but our friend is still up there on stage.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: It's a gat-danged hurricane all 'round the thing! We can't just go hoppin' on into that!

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Let's go backstage then!

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Okay!

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: C'mon, outta my way!

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Huh?
Go, brave children.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Thanks, old man!

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: I'll buy you a slice later!

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Thank ya kindly!
Haha, kids these days are so full of pep.
What's your plan now, Giovanna?

steps.name: Rossati Mafioso
steps.text: Donna Giovanna, we've got everything locked down. Let's get you out, while we still can.

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: Why?

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: It's a rare opportunity to watch a wonderful show from a fantastic seat. I'm going to have to savor this.

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: Sora, you really are her true friend, aren't you?

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: Now, how are you going to get up here, Cellinia?

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: Even if you find a shortcut, getting to me won't be easy.

steps.name: Rossati Mafioso
steps.text: But—

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: If I were to run away right now, do you think the Bellones and Saluzzos would just give up and call it quits?

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: This is a war now, my dear.

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: The Bellones and Saluzzos have decided to Signora Sicilia's ban on violence, and started a gang war.

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: Spread the word. There's only one thing we can do now: fight to the end.

steps.name: Rossati Mafioso
steps.text: Of course.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: Nngh...

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: Looks like 'fine Siracusan wine' was nothing special after all.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: I wouldn't gloat just yet... Columbian scum...

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: What—

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: Yes, I know. You Siracusans think the Columbian famiglie are just rowdy upstarts who haven't paid our dues.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: And yeah, there are a whole lot of incompetent idiots over in Columbia.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: But what about you?

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: Can you even sniff out the scent of blood under your so-called 'guns and order?'

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: We've never looked down on Siracusa.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: But from what I've seen today, you don't even deserve my attention.

steps.name: Rossati Mafioso
steps.text: Wallach, we've got a situation at the theater!

steps.name: Rossati Mafioso
steps.text: Someone blew the seats, and Cellinia is heading straight for the third floor.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: You've got five seconds for your last words.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: Last words?

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: Heh, what's there to say?

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: If you're really gonna do it, then tell Leontuzzo that I'm sorry.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: Sure.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: What—

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: Leon?!

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: You...

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: I'll handle this my way, Demetri.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: Signor Leontuzzo. Here I thought we could get along.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: You just lost your last chance for that.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: Well, well, well. Turns out the heir to a great famiglia just oozes charisma after all.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: You've made a fool of me, and still you tell me I had a chance to make things right.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: What's done is done.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: I'll make you a bet, Wallach.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: You're a betting man?

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: Hahahaha! Signor Leon, mio amico, we're not in a dining hall or one of our offices.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: We're in a war, and only one of us walking out of this alive.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Trust me, you'll love this one.

steps.name: Bellone Mafioso
steps.text: Ugh, these Rossatis are a pain in the ass.

steps.name: Bellone Mafioso
steps.text: Your Honor? We never heard you were joining us on this one.

steps.name: Bellone Mafioso
steps.text: And anyway, this ain't something you can just walk into.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: I'm not here to stop you. I'm not interested.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: I'm looking for someone.

steps.name: Bellone Mafioso
steps.text: Who?

steps.name: Bellone Mafioso
steps.text: We got one helluva mess here. Not gonna be easy to find anybody.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: All I need from you is to stay out of my way.

steps.name: Bellone Mafioso
steps.text: But...

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Even if I die here, that's none of Famiglia Bellone's business.

steps.name: Bellone Mafioso
steps.text: Suit yourself then.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: There you are.

steps.name: Rossati Mafioso
steps.text: Hold it.

steps.name: Carwash Worker
steps.text: I work here.

steps.name: Rossati Mafioso
steps.text: Uh huh. We got rid of all the workers.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Grr, what is he doing here?

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Look out, Dan—
Blood splatters, and a few drops splash across Lavinia's face.

steps.name: Carwash Worker
steps.text: Signorina Lavinia.

steps.name: Carwash Worker
steps.text: What are you doing here?
The 'path' opened by Lappland is doing its job. Only a short distance separates her from her old friend.
She lets out a soft sigh.
Chaos swirls all around her, but she knows what to do.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: I knew you'd come, Cellinia.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: What a look in your eyes there. It's like I'm the prey.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: Let's see what the Last Texas can do!

steps.name: Rubio
steps.text: Signor, Director... is this chaos... part of the show?

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: Chaos?

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: In my opinion, Segretario Rubio, everything is in perfect order.

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: What comes next will be even better.

steps.name: Rubio
steps.text: ...I see.

steps.name: Rubio
steps.text: You lead one of the most prestigious troupes in Volsinii, and you've put on a play unlike any other.

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: We do have an intermission coming up, though. You may tell me what it is you want from me.

steps.name: Rubio
steps.text: What I want... isn't very complicated.

steps.name: Rubio
steps.text: With Carracci's death, the seat of Ministro dei Lavori Pubblici is now vacant.

steps.name: Rubio
steps.text: You must be thinking about who the most suitable candidate is.

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: I take it you've decided you're that candidate?

steps.name: Rubio
steps.text: I don't think there's anyone else better suited than me.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: *cough* *cough*, *cough*, *cough*...

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: Wow... There's still mercy in you, at a time like this...

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: The Saluzzo Psycho isn't gonna finish me off?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: I'm not interested in a pointless fight with some punk who was never taking it seriously to begin with.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: ...Hah.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: What are you waiting for? What do you want?

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: I made a bet with someone. And I hope I lose.
Wallach looks in the direction Texas went. No one can stop her from assassinating Giovanna.
Except Giovanna herself.
There is nobody else in the empty room.
Texas immediately realizes what's happening, but it's too late. A knife is already up against her neck.

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: Since I came to Siracusa, I've been thinking of all the different ways someone might try to kill me.

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: But I never once thought it might be you.

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: And I never imagined you'd let your guard down, at a time like this.

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: Did you think that when I saw you'd, I'd give you a big hug and cry 'thank goodness, Cellinia, you're still alive?'

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: And then we'd sit down and share a drink and catch up on everything that's happened over the last few years?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: I'm here to kill you.

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: Great.
With that word, Giovanna drops the knife in her hand.
She wears a radiant smile on her face, her expression full of longing, as if the murderous intent from a moment ago was but a light-hearted joke.

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: Long time no see, Cellinia.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Long time no see, Giovanna.
